texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-001: B: Your call sign is Qantas 432, you are parking at gate 24, you have got information Hotel, ask Shanghai Delivery for ATC clearance to Beijing.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-002: C: Qantas 432, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use runway 26, Hotel Zulu 01 departure, initial climb to 600 meters on QNH, after departure, contact 128.75, squawk 3421.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-003: C: Qantas 432, read back correct, report when ready for push back and start up.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-004: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-005: C: Qantas 432, push back and start up approved.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-006: B: Now you are ready to taxi.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-007: C: Qantas 432, taxi via taxiway Foxtrot, Charlie 1 and Bravo to holding point runway 26. Caution! working progress at the end of gate 319.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-008: B: As you are taxing, you noticed some smoke coming from APU on Boeing 747 ahead of you, report this to ATC.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-009: B: Now you are holding point runway 26, tell ATC you are ready to takeoff.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-010: C: Qantas 432, behind landing traffic, line up behind.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-011: B: Now you are reaching 5100 meters, contact Beijing Approach and request further descent.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-012: C: Qantas 432, descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1031.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-013: B: Now you are maintaining 3300 meters, request further descent.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-014: C: Qantas 432, maintain 3300 meters, opposite traffic at 2 o'clock 10 miles, report clear of traffic.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-015: B: Tell the controller you are clear of traffic and request fly lower.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-016: B: You are cleared to 1200 meters, the sky is turning dark, the visibility is deteriorating, you suspect a sandstorm, tell Beijing Approach the situation and ask ATC if there is sandstorm forecast.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-017: B: The sandstorm is severe and the visibility is very poor, inform ATC the situation, ask to climb to a higher level to get above the sandstorm.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-018: C: Qantas 432, climb to 2100 meters, turn right heading 230.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-019: B: Your aircraft is Boeing 747, suddenly, number 1 number 2 engines have failed due to sandstorm, report it to Beijing Approach, ask if weather is clear in Beijing and request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing.
texts.atc-scenario-0001-card-main-020: C: Qantas 432, turn right heading 250, the weather in Beijing is clear.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-021: B: Your call sign is Qantas 160, a flight from Tokyo to Guangzhou, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over Whiskey X-Ray India, your transponder code is 4525, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-022: C: Qantas 160, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 10400 meters.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-023: B: You wish to know until what time you can expect high level, ask Zhengzhou Control.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-024: C: Qantas 160, Zhengzhou Control, you can expect further climb after passing Zulu Hotel Oscar, but for now, continue descend and maintain 9200 meters, reduced to minimum speed due to temporary airways restriction.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-025: C: Qantas 160, orbit right from present position until further advised.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-026: B: After several orbits, you have calculated that if you hold any longer, the fuel on board will approach the required minimums, inform Zhengzhou Control about your situation.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-027: C: Qantas 160, Zhengzhou Control, roger, after this orbit, direct to AKOMA.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-028: B: Now you find you don't have enough fuel to fly to Guangzhou and you decide to divert to Changsha Airport, notify Zhengzhou Control.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-029: C: Qantas 160, stand by for your request, temporary restriction is now cancelled, resume normal speed, direct to OBLIK.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-030: B: You have a navigation system problem, your instrument is showing inaccurate position of your aircraft, notify Zhengzhou Control and ask for radar monitoring.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-031: C: Qantas 160, roger, you are slightly deviating to the left, turn right 5 degrees, contact Wuhan Control on 134.7, request diversion from Wuhan Control.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-032: B: Now you are maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 4525, contact Wuhan Control.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-033:
C: Qantas 160, Wuhan Control, radar contact, I understand you have a navigation problem and fuel shortage, confirm you are diverting to Changsha.
B: Tell Wuhan Control you are performing the checklist and tell Wuhan Control to stand by.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-034: B: Inform Wuhan Control you are flying with basic navigation instruments and you want to change your alternate airport to Wuhan Airport.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-035: C: Qantas 160, roger, divert to Wuhan approved, descend and maintain 4800 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 120.45 when reaching.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-036: B: Now you are reaching 4800 meters, you have got information Bravo, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-037: C: Qantas 160, Wuhan approach, radar contact, information Bravo is current, follow Zulu Foxtrot 01 Alpha arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36 right.
texts.atc-scenario-0002-card-main-038:
C: Qantas 160, are you declaring fuel emergency?
B: Inform the controller that you still have more than 2 hours fuel endurance and you are not declaring a fuel emergency.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-039: B: Your call sign is Qantas 923, you are near departure time, however 1 passenger is missing while his checked luggage is still on board, for security reasons, contact Company operations to offload the baggage.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-040: B: Now you are at gate 51, you have got information Whiskey, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-041: C: Qantas 923, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, runway 36 right, Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-042: C: Qantas 923, expect 10 minutes delay due taxiway Alpha 3 is temporarily blocked by a broken down vehicle.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-044: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-045: C: Qantas 923, there is a Citation next to you being pushed, once the aircraft is clear, push back onto Zulu 4, abeam gate 213, facing east.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-046: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-047: C: Qantas 923, taxi via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha to holding point runway 36 right.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-048: B: As you are taxing on taxiway Alpha 3, you notice several baggage are scattered on Alpha 3, about 400 meters ahead of your aircraft, tell Ground control why you have stopped taxing and ask ground services to retrieve the baggage.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-049: C: Qantas 923, hold position, we have notified the ground handling department.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-050: C: Qantas 923, taxiway Alpha 3 is clear, expedite taxi via taxiway Alpha 3 and Alpha to holding point runway 36 right.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-051: B: Now you are airborne, leaving 1200 meters for 2400 meters, contact Wuhan Departure and request further climb.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-052: C: Qantas 923, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, expedite climb to 6000 meters due crossing traffic.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-053: B: During climbing, 1 of your hydraulic systems has failed, make an Urgency call and ask to level off at 4500 meters and then return to land at Wuhan Airport.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-054: C: Qantas 923, climb and maintain 4500 meters, turn left, track direct to Lima Kilo Oscar, expect Lima Kilo Oscar 02 Alpha arrival, ILS approach runway 36 right.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-055: C: Qantas 923, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1012.
texts.atc-scenario-0003-card-main-057: B: The purser informs you that a passenger has become ill, possibly suffering from hyperventilation, ask for an ambulance to wait at the gate.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-058: B: Your call sign is Qantas 029, your destination is Dubai, you are going to depart from Beijing airport at Gate 302. Now call Beijing Delivery, and request ATC clearance.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-059: C: Qantas 029, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Dubai, via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600 meters, RENOB 32 departure, request level change for 11000 meters en route, squawk 1725, runway 36 right, departure frequency 127.75.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-060: C: Qantas 029, read back correct, contact ground 121.9, good day.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-061: B: You are ready to start up engines, call Ground.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-064: B: You are ready for pushback now, call Ground.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-066: B: You have a problem: during pushback, the tow-bar is bent and you have to wait for another 1. Tell the controller.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-067:
C: Qantas 029, roger, call me back when ready to taxi.
B: You are ready for taxiing, call Ground.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-068: C: Qantas 029, taxi via taxiway Alpha 4 and Bravo 1 to holding point 36 right.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-069: C: Qantas 029, taxi slower, give way to the Airbus coming from your right.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-070: C: Qantas 029, taxi with caution, work in progress on right side of the taxiway.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-072: B: You now find your nose wheel steering seems to be jammed, tell the controller.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-073:
C: Qantas 029, do you require a tug?
B: Say yes, you need towing assistance.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-074: C: Qantas 029, roger, hold and standby for a few minutes while I'll get a tug for you.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-075: B: You are now airborne, time 32, you are passing 1200 meters and climbing to 1800 meters, contact Beijing Departure.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-076: C: Qantas 029, cancel SID, turn left direct to Charlie Delta, climb to and maintain 6600 meters.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-077: B: Your primary display system has a fault, request return to Beijing.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-078:
C: Qantas 029, say again please, I read you 2.
B: Tell the controller that the primary display system of yours broke down, only the co-pilot's display is working. For safety's sake, you want to return to Beijing.
texts.atc-scenario-0004-card-main-079: C: Qantas 029, roger, turn left heading 180, radar vector to land.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-080: B: Your call sigh is Qantas 358, from Singapore to Wuhan. You are maintaining 10100 meters over DAPRO, squawking 3625, contact Wuhan Control.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-081: C: Qantas 358, Wuhan control, radar contact, descend to and maintain 6300 meters at your discretion.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-082: B: Your weather radar indicates a large group of CBs, southwest of Lima Kilo Oscar, request turn right heading 050 to avoid the weather.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-083:
C: Qantas 358, negative heading 050 due to the restricted area.
B: Tell Wuhan Control you want to fly heading 030 for at least 5 minutes before you can resume course.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-084: C: Qantas 358, roger, heading 030 is approved, when clear of weather, track direct to Lima Kilo Oscar.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-086: B: You are maintaining 5100 meters, over Lima Kilo Oscar, ATIS Bravo received, now contact Wuhan Approach.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-087: C: Qantas 358, Wuhan Approach, Lima Kilo Oscar 2 Alpha arrival, descend to and maintain 1200 meters, be advise current information Charlie, you are number 1.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-088: B: Your weather radar has failed during descent, contact Wuhan Approach to request weather information along your route.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-089: C: Qantas 358, roger, our weather radar shows cumulonimbus in the vicinity of Delta Alpha.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-090: B: Request Wuhan Approach for radar assistance to intercept final cause of runway 36 left.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-091: C: Qantas 358, turn right heading 090, descend to and maintain 900 meters.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-092: C: Qantas 358, turn left heading 030, descend to and maintain 600 metres, cleared to intercept the localizer runway 36 left, contact Tower 124.35.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-093: B: You encountered the downdrafts on short final and executed a missed approach, informed Wuhan Tower.
texts.atc-scenario-0005-card-main-094: C: Qantas 358, roger, when able turn right heading 090, climb to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach 119.7.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-095: B: Your call sigh is Qantas 701, flying from Sydney to Wuhan, you are cruising at 10700 meters and squawking 3211, you are now entering Wuhan Control area, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-096: C: Qantas 701, radar contact, maintain 10700 meters.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-097: B: There is a thunderstorm buildup near Lima Kilo Oscar, asked how the preceding aircraft avoided the weather.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-098: B: Tell Wuhan Control you want to deviate 20 miles to the east to avoid weather.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-099: B: You are approaching the top of decent point but there are CBs at lower level, ask Wuhan Control to delay your descent.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-100: B: There are thunderstorms sources the south of the airport, arrival through Lima Kilo Oscar is difficult, ask Wuhan Control for an approach from the North and use Zulu Foxtrot arrivals.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-101: C: Qantas 701, turn right heading 020, expect Zulu Foxtrot 02 arrival.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-102: B: There is a small cumulonimbus in front of you, request maneuver to the right within 2 miles.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-103: B: During descent, your nose wheel steering failed, informed Wuhan Approach of the situation and tell him that you will stop on the runway after landing.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-104: B: You are told to use the runway 22 VOR DME approach, but the weather is deteriorating, ask Wuhan Tower for an ILS approach runway 18 left.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-105: C: Qantas 701, ILS approach runway 18 left is approved.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-106: B: The approach lights are not bright enough, asked Tower to increase the brightness of the approach lights.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-107: B: You executed missed approach because of poor visibility, inform Tower.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-108: C: Qantas 701, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-109: B: The visibility has improved, expect radar vectors for another approach.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-110: C: Qantas 701, turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS approach runway 18 left.
texts.atc-scenario-0006-card-main-111: B: You have landed at Wuhan Airport, but the tow truck is not in position, ask for a tug.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-112: B: Your call sign is Singapore 852, you are at Wuhan Airport, stand 7, received ATIS Mike, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-113: C: Singapore 852, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, follow Zulu Foxtrot 03 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, runway 18 left, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-114: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-115: C: Singapore 852, push back and start up at your own discretion.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-116: B: You have completed the push back and start up procedures. You decide to make an intersection departure from Echo 2, contact Ground to request intersection departure from Echo 2.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-117: C: Singapore 852, roger, intersection departure from Echo 2 is approved, taxi to Echo 2 via Alpha 6, Alpha 2, hold short of runway 18 left.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-118: B: During taxing you find a vehicle broken down on taxiway Alpha, you have stopped the aircraft, inform ATC about the situation and request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-119: C: Singapore 852, roger, hold at present position, RAM services will be assume in a few minutes.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-120: B: You are now holding short of runway 18 left on Echo 2, request departure.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-121: C: Singapore 852, cleared for takeoff runway 18 left.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-122: B: During the takeoff role, your nose will run over a sharp object on the runway surface and the nose wheel tire burst, you aborted the takeoff, notify Wuhan Tower.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-123: B: Inform ATC about the situation and request fire trucks and maintenance.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-124:
C: Singapore 852, roger, do you require anything else?
B: Tell the ATC that you require a tug to tow your aircraft back to the apron after inspection.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-125: C: Singapore 852, tug is on the way.
texts.atc-scenario-0007-card-main-126: B: Request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-127: B: Your call sign is Singapore 123, stand 215, from Wuhan to Singapore, information Bravo received, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-128: C: Singapore 123, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, Lima killer Oscars 01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, runaway 36 right, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 6325.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-129: B: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-130: C: Singapore 123, push back and start up approved, facing east.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-131: B: While being pushed back, the tow bar bent, contact Ground to request another tow bar.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-132: B: While taxing, you notice the wind sock shows a strong tailwind, contact Tower to check the wind.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-133:
C: Singapore 123, surface wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Tower to change to runway 18 left and state the reason.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-134: B: You have departed from runway 18 left, shortly after lift off you encountered a bird strike, your right engine has failed, make an Emergency call, request to maintain runway heading.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-135: B: Tell the Tower you want to dump fuel and return to Wuhan Airport.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-136: C: Singapore 123, roger, turn right heading 240 to intercept Lima Kilo Oscar VOR 030 radio inbound, climb to 3000 meters.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-137:
C: Singapore 123, advise the time required for fuel jettison.
B: Tell the controller you need approximately 25 minutes.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-138: C: Singapore 123, after passing Lima Kilo Oscar, heading 220, maintain 3000 meters, report when over Lima Kilo Oscar.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-139: B: You are over Lima Kilo Oscar, call Wuhan Control.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-140: B: Tell Wuhan Approach fuel dumping is now completed, request radar vectors for runway 22.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-141: C: Singapore 123, turn right track direct to Delta Alpha, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect runway 22.
texts.atc-scenario-0008-card-main-142: B: You are now established on ILS approach runway 22, contact Tower.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-143: B: You are encountering severe icing at flight level 390 and want lower.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-144: C: Singapore 101, descend to flight level 310, reach 310 within 4 minutes.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-145: B: During descent, you observed lightning to your right and the aircraft was shaking, you suspect you have suffered lightning strike, tell ATC the situation and request 10 miles deviation to the left.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-146: C: Singapore 101, deviation 10 miles to the left is approved.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-147: B: Now the purser reports there is a strange smell coming from the rear cabin, tell ATC the situation and request further descent as precaution.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-148: C: Singapore 101, continue descent to flight level 250.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-149:
C: Singapore 101, are you carrying any dangerous cargo?
B: Tell ATC you are carrying some flammable liquid in the aft cargo compartment.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-150:
C: Singapore 101, roger that.
B: Now smoke is coming out of the floor in the aft cabin, so you decide immediately to divert to HongKong. Declare an emergency and make a Distress call.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-151: C: Singapore 101, roger your MAYDAY, fly heading 010 and descend to flight level 110.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-152: B: Tell ATC you may stop on the runway and evacuate passengers there.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-153:
C: Singapore 101, copy that, what kind of emergency services do you need?
B: Tell ATC you need fire service and medical service to be attendance near the runway.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-154:
C: Singapore 101, fire and medical services, copy that.
B: After having discharged the fire extinguisher and applied the smoke procedure, the smoke is stopped and is controlled. Tell ATC your situation and cancel the Distress.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-155:
C: Singapore 101, roger, do you want to continue to HongKong?
B: Tell ATC you still need to land at HongKong as a precaution.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-158: C: Singapore 101, descend to 4000 feet, heading 340 to join right base, report airfield in sight.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-159: B: Tell ATC you need to park in a remote area and disembark the passengers there.
texts.atc-scenario-0009-card-main-160: C: Singapore 101, we will relay your request to flight operations department.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-161: B: Your call sign is Singapore 497, you are parking at gate 215, you have got information Papa, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-162: C: Singapore 497, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initial altitude 1800 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, departure frequency 118.9, squawk 2706.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-163: B: Tell ATC 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, request 9500 meters.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-164: C: Singapore 497, cleared cruising level 9500 meters.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-165: B: You are on the taxiway Alpha with engine running, contact Ground.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-166: C: Singapore 497, taxi to holding point runway 36 right via Zulu 4 and Alpha, hold short of Echo 7.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-167: B: Contact Wuhan Tower and request intersection departure Echo 5 runway 36 right.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-168: C: Singapore 497, negative due sequencing, continue to holding point runway 36 right, hold short of Echo 7.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-169: C: Singapore 497, cleared for takeoff runway 36 right, surface wind 350, 5 knots.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-171: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-172: C: Singapore 497, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn left direct to Delta Alpha, climb and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1021.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-173: B: You are approaching Singapore Airport, contact Approach.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-174: B: Your landing gear can't be extended normally, report this situation to ATC.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-175:
C: Singapore 497, what's your intention?
B: Tell ATC you want to terminate the approach, maintain runway heading, climb to 600 meters to complete the abnormal procedures.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-176: B: Your landing gear has been extended manually, but nose wheel steering is lost, request a tug after landing.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-177: C: Roger, Singapore 497, the tug will be ready upon landing.
texts.atc-scenario-0010-card-main-178: C: Singapore 497, you are number 1 to land, cleared ILS approach runway 18 left, report established.
texts.atc-scenario-0011-card-main-179: B: Your call sign is Singapore 323, a flight from Wuhan to Singapore, you are at gate Echo 3, with information Charlie, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
texts.atc-scenario-0011-card-main-180: C: Singapore 323, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, departure runway 36 right, follow Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3763.
texts.atc-scenario-0011-card-main-181: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
texts.atc-scenario-0011-card-main-182: C: Singapore 323, push back and start up approved, facing east.
texts.atc-scenario-0011-card-main-183: B: You have completed push back with engines running, you are ready for taxi.

texts.atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1699: B: You realize that the tug is not in position yet, advise Ground control you need another 5 minutes to be ready.
texts.atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1700: C: China Eastern 5118, roger, stand by for push, I will call you back.
texts.atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1701:
C: China Eastern 5118, are you fully ready now?we have a slot time for departure in 10 minutes.
B: You need to open the cabin door to add passenger food and drinks due to the long delay, advise Ground you will need another 5 minutes for catering.
texts.atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1702:
C: China Eastern 5118, roger, report ready.
B: 5 minutes later, catering completed, call ready.
texts.atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1703: C: Push back approved until abeam gate 221, do not block gate 222, there is incoming traffic to that gate.
texts.atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1704: B: Engine start completed, now request taxi.
texts.atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1705: C: China Eastern 5118, taxi via Mike, Alpha, hold short of Echo 1.
texts.atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1706:
C: Can you accept Echo 1 intersection for departure?Takeoff roll distance available 3300 meters.
B: Tell the Tower you can accept.
texts.atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1707:
C: China Eastern 5118, roger, line up and wait via taxiway Echo 1.
B: Report to the Tower that the aircraft in front of you is blocking Echo 1.
texts.atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1708:
C: China Eastern 5118, roger, break! break! China Southern 328, taxi forward to be clear of Echo 1.
B: The aircraft moved, you are able to continue taxi and line up.
texts.atc-scenario-0098-card-main-1709: C: China Eastern 5118, cleared for takeoff, runway 18 left, initially maintain runway heading, climb to 1500 meters.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1710: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 277, you are parking at gate 213, you have received information Mike, request ATC clearance to London Heathrow from Wuhan Delivery.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1711: C: China Eastern 277, cleared to London Heathrow via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb 2700 meters, Lima Kilo Oscar 02 departure, cruising level 8400 meters, squawk 2512.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1712: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1713: C: China Eastern 277, taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Alpha 4, Echo 2, hold short of runway 36 right.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1714: B: Now you are holding short of runway 36 right, contact the controller to request cross the runway 36 right.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1715: C: China Eastern 277, expedite cross runway 36 right, report vacated.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1716: B: Now you have exited runway 36 right, report it to Wuhan Tower.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1717: B: Now you are holding short of runway 04, you are ready for departure.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1718: C: China Eastern 277, after departure, climb straight ahead until 600 meters, follow SID, direct to Lima Kilo Oscar, contact Wuhan Departure 120.2, cleared for takeoff runway 04.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1719: B: After takeoff, your flaps seem to be jammed, report the situation to Wuhan Approach and request hold for further check.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1720: C: China Eastern 277, roger, turn right, direct to Lima Kilo Oscar, hold at Lima Kilo Oscar VOR 210 radio, hold at 3300 meters, inbound track 280 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time 1 minute.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1721: B: After performing the checklist, the flap problem can't be solved, report it to Wuhan Approach and request return to land.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1722: C: China Eastern 277, turn right heading 340, follow Lima Kilo Oscar 03 Alpha arrival, expect ILS approach runway 04.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1723: B: You can't fully extend the flaps, tell Wuhan Tower that you need to land on the longest runway.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1724: C: China Eastern 277, turn right heading 030 to join right hand downwind runway 04.
texts.atc-scenario-0099-card-main-1725: C: China Eastern 277, cleared to land, runway 04.
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1726: B: Your call sign is Air China 102, now call Wuhan Departure and report you are 400 meters, climbing.
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1727:
C: Air China 102, Wuhan Departure is with you. Continue climb to 4200 meters. Pass Hekou at 4200 meters.
B: Acknowledge the controller’s instruction
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1728: B: As the aircraft is reaching 4200 meters, you suddenly find No.1 engine has flamed out. You declare an emergency.
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1729:
C: Roger PAN, Air China 102, what is your intention?
B: Tell controller you intend to return to land as soon as possible.
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1730: C: Air China 102, turn left proceed to Hotel Golf, make straight in ILS approach runway 18 left.
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1731:
C: Air China 102, contact Tower 124.35.
B: Call Tower.
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1732: B: You have another problem. The hydraulic pressure is dropping rapidly.
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1733:
C: Air China 102, Can you extend the landing gear?
B: You are not certain if you could extend the gear. You are going around.
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1734:
C: Air China 102, standard missed approach.
B: You are flying to the holding for further check of the landing gear.
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1735: B: You have tried several ways, but you could not extend the landing gear. You decided to make a belly landing. Tell the controller about it
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1736:
C: Air China 102, any airport assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you like the runway to be foamed at the touch down zone of the landing runway.
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1737:
C: Air China 102, roger. We will spray foam around the touch down.
B: You ask how long will foam-spay last.
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1738:
C: Air China 102, foam spraying will last 15 minutes. I will call you back.
B: Tell controller you would like to land as soon as possible
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1739:
C: Air China 102, cleared to land runway 18 left, wind 120, 10 knots.
B: You confirm with the controller if the landing runway is 18 Left.
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1740:
C: Correct, Air China 102, landing runway 18 left, report runway in sight.
B: You have runway in sight, report to Tower.
texts.atc-scenario-0100-card-main-1741: C: Air China 102, cleared to land.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1742: B: Your call sign is Singapore 544. Now you are on the way taxiing to the holding point.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1743: C: Singapore 544, frozen icy patches on your taxiway, I suggest turning right and using taxiway Golf instead.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1744:
C: Singapore 544, go beyond Airbus 320 on your left, then turn right.
B: Read back theinstruction. Then tell the controller an aircraft is approaching to you from the opposite direction
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1745: C: Singapore 544, disregard the traffic, Boeing 737, he is on his way to the parking stand after you.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1746: B: Call Ground and ask if the Ground controller may ask the Airbus 320 to pull in to further left, you want to pass it due your slot time will be expired at 30.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1747:
C: Singapore 544, your airplane has been impounded by the airport authorities.
B: You ask the reason.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1748:
C: I don’t know the exact reason. The only thing I know is that you have not been cleared by Customs.
B: You tell the controller that you have the clearance sheet together with a waybill.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1749:
C: It is not an ATC matter. I am only passing the message.
B: You ask the controller to help you find the reason.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1750:
C: Singapore 544, I have just received the airport authority information that there is a suspected person, perhaps a criminal with a bomb aboard your aircraft.
B: Ask the control what you should do.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1751:
C: Singapore 544, tell the passengers that there is a technical problem. You have to return to the remote apron for repairing.
B: You make a captain announcement.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1752: C: Singapore 544, enter the runway and expedite taxiing on the runway. Exit the runway via Echo 4.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1753: B: You contact Ground and report you have vacated the runway 36 right via Echo 4.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1754: C: Singapore 544, take taxiway Alpha 8, direct to apron No.5.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1755: B: Report you have reached Apron No.5.
texts.atc-scenario-0101-card-main-1756: C: Singapore 544, wait there. Don’t let the passengers get off the aircraft. The policemen will be on the scene in a minute.
texts.atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1757: B: Your call sign is China Southern 426, at gate 410, ask Beijing East Ground for taxi instruction.
texts.atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1758: C: China Southern 426, taxi to holding point of runway 36 right via Yankee 1 and Charlie 1.
texts.atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1759: B: Now you’re on the taxiway Charlie 1, you got the report from the purser that 1 passenger had boarded the wrong airplane. Request back to the gate.
texts.atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1760: C: China Southern 426, backtrack at present position, back to the gate via Charlie 1 and Yankee 1.
texts.atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1761: B: Half an hour later, you ask Ground for permission of taxiing again.
texts.atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1762: C: China Southern 426, taxi to holding point of runway 36 right via Yankee 1 and Charlie 1.
texts.atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1763: C: China Southern 426, hold short at intersection between Yankee 1 and Tango 2, 1 Airbus 330 taxiing east on taxiway Tango 2.
texts.atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1764: C: China Southern 426, after Airbus 330 vacating intersection, continue to taxi.
texts.atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1765: B: Your aircraft left wingtip collided with left stabilizer of Airbus 330 during taxing, report it to the controller and ask for assistance.
texts.atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1766: C: China Southern 426, I’ve reported it to relevant departments. And investigation car is on the way.
texts.atc-scenario-0102-card-main-1767: B: You reported the accident to the company and you got the company’s decision that the passengers would be arranged for another airplane, you request the controller to send shuttle bus soon.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1768: B: Your call sign is Air China 102, now call Wuhan Approach and report you are 10 miles north of Hekou, you are continuing approaching.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1769:
C: Air China 102, Wuhan Approach is with you. Have you got the current ATIS？
B: You give an affirmative reply and report that you have received information Lima.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1770: B: Suddenly you find a sharp drop in RPM, report you have a trouble with starboard engine.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1771:
C: Air China 102, what is your intention?
B: Tell the controller you intend to land with radar vector.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1772: C: Air China 102, continue on your present heading, radar will vector you to ILS approach.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1773: B: Ask if you could get any airport assistance there, your engine needs maintenance.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1774:
C: Affirm. Maintenance is available at this airport. I will continue to give you instructions and give you all the important information. Are you able to maintain 4200 meters ?
B: Tell the controller you could.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1775: B: 15 minutes later, you have established localizer, report to the controller.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1776: C: Air China 102, descend to 900 meters on QNH 1012, cleared ILS approach runway 18 right.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1777: C: Air China 102, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1778: B: Contact Tower and report you had bird strike.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1779:
C: Air China 102, report your intention.
B: You request to reduce speed to minimum approach speed. You also report that No.1 left windshield is cracked. The inner glass pane become broken.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1780: C: Air China 102, reduce to minimum approach speed. Report runway in sight.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1781: C: Air China 102, visibility is 8 miles, wind 270 at 10 knots, QNH 1013, landing runway 18 right.
texts.atc-scenario-0103-card-main-1782: B: You have runway in sight, report it to Tower.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1783: B: Your call sign is China Southern 303, now call Guangzhou Control and tell him you’ve just passed 3600 meters.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1784: C: China Southern 303, roger, continue climbing to level 4200 meters on QNH 1014.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1785: B: You find a gradual ice build-up. You think that might be caused by de-icing equipment failure. Require descent to below the freezing level.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1786: C: China Southern 303, roger, descend 3000 meters, QNH 1014.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1787:
C: China Southern 303, let me know if you require lower, do emergency conditions exist at the moment?
B: You reply that the current level is ok but the de-ice system still refuses working. The emergency condition is still existing.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1788:
C:  Roger, China Southern 303.
B: Tell the controller you intend to dump fuel for 15 minutes then return to land.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1789: C: China Southern 303, understand, turn right heading 330, expect Runway 02 left.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1790:
C: China Southern 303, do you expect your approach and landing to be normal?
B: Give an affirmative reply.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1791:
C: China Southern 303, orbit left from your present position, you may have wide orbits, fuel dumping approved, report on completion.
B: Read-back and tell the controller you’re commencing the fuel dumping.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1792: B: Tell the controller fuel dumping completed, and request a further clearance.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1793:
C: China Southern 303, roger, fly heading 320 and contact Approach on 130.0.
B: Read-back and you are not sure of the Approach frequency. You hear it as 120.0.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1794: C: China Southern 303, negative, contact Approach on 130.0.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1795: B: Contact Baiyun Approach, tell him you have got information Golf.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1796: C: China Southern 303, Approach, descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1014, Left pattern Runway 02 left, 20 miles to run.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1797: B: Report you have a flap extension problem caused by prior icing issue, perhaps a micro-switch malfunction. You will conduct a flapless landing.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1798: C: China Southern 303, roger, change of Runway 02 right, which is 200 meters longer. Turn right heading 200 for downwind, now with 10 miles to touchdown, maintain 1200 meters.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1799: C: China Southern 303, contact Baiyun Tower on 118.1. We have notified your condition to Tower.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1801: C: China Southern 303, roger, continue descend to 900 meters on QNH, you are NO.1.
texts.atc-scenario-0104-card-main-1802: C: China Southern 303, extend downwind as you wish, turn left at your own discretion to join base. Mind your speed !
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1803:
B: Your call sign is China Southern 230. The aircraft has just landed on runway 02 right of Baiyun Airport.
C: China Southern 230, backtrack the runway, vacate the runway via Alpha 5.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1804: C: China Southern 230, visibility 300 meters, low visibility procedure in effect, taxi with caution.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1805: C: China Southern 230, expedite vacating runway, traffic on short final. Contact Baiyun Ground on 120.2.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1806: B: Now contact Baiyun Ground and tell him you have vacated runway
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1807: C: China Southern 230, stand 35 via taxiway Alpha 5, Alpha, Golf, Echo and Quebec.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1808: B: You find the taxiway lighting is very dim, and ask for brightening them up.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1809:
C: China Southern 230, already on its maximum setting. Taxi with caution.
B: You tell controller that you need a detailed instruction.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1810: C: China Southern 230, taxi straight ahead, I’ll keep you advised.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1811:
C: China Southern 230, give way to the outbound traffic on your right, report have it in sight.
B: Tell him you have not found the aircraft.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1812: C: China Southern 230, hold at present position. Traffic is crossing right to left.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1813: C: China Southern 230, continue taxi, Alpha is the first taxiway on your left.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1814: C: China Southern 230, follow taxiway Alpha till next intersection, then right.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1815:
C: China Southern 230, you’ve taken a wrong turn. Now you are on Echo Charlie.
B: Apologize to the controller, and ask him what you should do next.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1816: C: Ah, China Southern 230, continue taxi. Once reaching Cargo Apron, make a right 180. Make sure you have enough space to do it.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1817: B: Tell him you have made a 180.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1818: C: China Southern 230, taxi eastward via previous route. Do not turn unless I call you.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1819: C: China Southern 230, now turn right onto taxiway Quebec. Caution, taxiway is slippery.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1820: B: Your right main gear skidded off the taxiway. Ask for a tug.
texts.atc-scenario-0105-card-main-1821: C: China Southern 230, copied that. Wait a minute.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1822: B: You are over Tango Oscar Golf at 35, flight level 210, you want to descend to flight level 170, report to Guangzhou Control.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1823:
C: Air Canada 412, can you make flight level 190 by Tango Uniform X-Ray ?
B: You want flight level 170 because the turbulence is likely to get worse further along the route.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1824: C: Air Canada 412, we have to coordinate.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1825: C: Air Canada 412, your request to Tango Uniform X-Ray flight level 170 has been approved, at the same time, remain on 215 radial Golf India Lima VOR.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1826: B: You want to put off the descent, call Control.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1827:
C: Descend immediately due traffic.
B: You tell the controller that you will run into CBs if you descend right now.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1828: C: Turn right heading 120 to detour the CBs.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1829: B: You tell the controller that you will check out more than 30 miles if you go round the CBs from the right. You ask the permission of a left sight.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1830:
C: There is only 15 miles for you to go if you want to detour from the left due resticted area.
B: You need 20 miles.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1831: C: I will contact with the military, standby.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1832:
C: No reply from the military, what do you prefer?
B: You intend to go round the CBs from the left.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1833:
C: Air Canada 412, cleared to detour the thunderstorm from the left.
B: You ran into severe turbulence in CBs, some persons injured.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1834:
C: Air Canada 412, what's your intention?
B: You want priority landing and medical assistance.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1835: C: Air Canada 412, emergency services will be notified. Ambulance will be there waiting for you.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1836: B: Declare Urgency due to port inboard engine flamed out resulting from water ingestion, you are suffering a steep left turn.
texts.atc-scenario-0106-card-main-1837:
C: Air Canada 412, roger PAN, report your intention if available.
B: You want emergency landing.
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1838: B: Your call sigh is Air Canada 123. The aircraft is parking on the apron and you are ready for ATC clearance. Now contact Delivery for ATC clearance.
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1839: C: Air Canada 123, you are cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, cruise level 10200 meters, Delta 06 departure, squawk 2315.
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1840: B: You tell the controller that the original flight direct to Beijing has been revised.
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1841: C: Air Canada 123, I am sorry, I have not got your latest flight plan. Hold on, I will call you back.
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1842:
C: Air Canada 123, your flight plan has been amended, you’ll divert to Charlie Oscar Golf to pick up some cargo and transit passengers, is that right?
B: Tell the controller Yes.
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1843:
C: Air Canada 123, have you received departure information?
B: You have got information Kilo, but you don’t know the present information code. You ask about it.
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1844:
C: Information Kilo is not valid, Information Lima is current.
B: Tell the controller you are going to write down the present ATIS.
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1845: B: Contact the Ground controller and tell him you have to delay the departure for about 10 minutes, the moving jet-way to the satellite is not working properly.
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1846:
C: Air Canada 123, you would expect a delay of 1 hour if you don’t make this slot.
B: Tell the controller that the moving walkway has been fixed. All the passengers will be on the aircraft in a few minutes, but the luggage loading is too slow due an old fashioned loader, you request the controller to inform the ground handling and send a new loader as soon as possible.
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1847:
C: Air Canada 123, I am sorry, there is no loader on hand now.
B: You would like to know if you would be delayed for an hour.
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1848:
C: Affirm. My apologies, there is no spare loader at the moment.
B: Contact the Ground controller and tell him that you are ready for engine start up
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1849:
C: Air Canada 123, startup approved.
B: You tell the controller that the ground mechanic has found that No.1 engine is leaking fuel.
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1850:
C: Is the leakage serious? What is your intention?
B: You tell the controller that the starboard engine fuel line has been leaking slightly. You are not certain if you can continue the flight. You will contact with the company dispatcher.
texts.atc-scenario-0107-card-main-1851:
C: Air Canada 123, your clearance will expire then, I’ll give you a new slot when you are ready.
B: You tell the controller that your flight has to be cancelled.
